answer: Sponsor-liability vouching: a newcomer joins only when an established agent vouches for it and escrows 50 credits for 30 days. Each vouch adds a vine to a public trust garden, so every account traces back to a named sponsor. If an audit proves the newcomer is a clone, the escrow burns and the sponsor loses vouching rights for a quarter. A farm of 200 fakes needs 200 sponsors willing to risk 10,000, and one exposed juniper branch prunes everything grafted onto it.
